title: MiniMax Music 3
description: MiniMax Music 3 is a high-performance music generation model for creating complete songs up to five minutes long

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.tooltip: Music description: style, mood, vocals, instrumentation and arrangement. For precise control use a Structured Caption with global metadata (genre, BPM, key, emotional progression), vocal details, and a section-by-section arrangement.

inputs.name: lyrics
inputs.tooltip: The lyrics to sing. Structure tags such as [intro], [verse], [pre-chorus], [chorus], [post-chorus], [bridge], [instrumental], [solo] and [outro] must each be on their own line; text on the same line as a leading tag is dropped by the model's input contract.

inputs.name: duration
inputs.tooltip: Upper bound on the generated audio length in seconds. The model may stop earlier; the actual duration is returned in the output.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.tooltip: Random seed for reproducibility. If not provided, a random seed will be used. -1 leaves it to the model.

inputs.name: num_inference_steps
inputs.tooltip: Number of flow-matching Euler steps per 8-second denoising chunk. More steps improve quality at the cost of speed.

inputs.name: guidance_scale
inputs.tooltip: Classifier-free guidance scale of the flow-matching stage.
